items.title: Sam LaPorta: Big chunk play in win
items.text:
LaPorta brought in three of six targets for 62 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.title: Chuba Hubbard: Two more TDs in Week 11 win
items.text:
Hubbard carried the ball 27 times for 120 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens. He added a two-point conversion.

items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Two catches in Week 11 loss
items.text:
Egbuka brought in two of five targets for 18 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
